description:
The Huffy Extent 26-Inch Mountain Bike is made for riders who are ready to venture beyond the pavement and explore with confidence. Featuring a durable steel hardtail frame in a striking satin vintage green finish, this bike combines rugged capability with everyday reliability, making it the perfect companion for trails, park paths, and neighborhood rides.
A front suspension fork helps absorb bumps and uneven terrain for a smoother, more comfortable ride wherever the adventure leads. The 21-speed drivetrain, equipped with MicroShift shifters and a Shimano rear derailleur, delivers smooth, reliable gear changes that make climbs easier, descents more controlled, and every ride more enjoyable.
Front and rear disc brakes provide dependable stopping power in wet or dry conditions, giving riders confidence when the trail gets challenging. Wide 26” x 2.4” tires offer steady traction across dirt, gravel, and pavement, while the padded ATB saddle and Krayton grips help keep longer rides comfortable. Whether it’s a weekend trail ride or a daily spin around town, the Huffy Extent is built to help riders go farther and explore more.
